calibration.sample_definition: fixed public SourceCraft sample selected 2026-09-20 from global /repos catalog; 5 high-rating/mature, 5 oldest, 5 newest, 12 language quota, 9 deterministic hash, 1 real fixture anchor

semantic_review.Activity~CI/CD: recency/automation can co-vary; not duplicate because one is Git history and one is run outcomes
semantic_review.Activity~Issues: related maintenance populations but different event sources and denominators
semantic_review.Code Health~CI/CD: test/automation maturity may co-vary; CI failure is delivery reliability, Code Health is maintainability/structure
semantic_review.Documentation~Code Health: both inspect files but Vale prose and code maintainability have disjoint populations
